root_cohort.environment: Ubuntu 24.04 WSL, actual UID 0, isolated venv and Linux scratch

nonroot_cohort.mechanism: Drop privileges only in the owned subprocess using setgroups/setgid/setuid. No OS user/group/service is added or changed. The two root-skipped tests pass without UID/stat mocking.

coverage: The earlier Windows POSIX/dependency failure groups plus all five formerly uncollectable modules, across ten selected files. This is a targeted cohort, not a full API run.
initial_environment_attempts: WSL n1 created a venv under /tmp, but it was absent after WSL restarted. No tests ran in that failed invocation, and no systemd/service repair was attempted.
WSL n2 builds and runs in one invocation; the ten-file cohort passes with the two explicit root skips.

Full API n3 setup succeeded but native Linux Git could not resolve the Windows worktree's C: gitdir pointer. That pointer was not rewritten. Full API n4 uses a native-Windows-Git physical source manifest and verifies 630 source files before/after the Linux run.
full_api_n4: 4376 cases collected, disjoint 2188/2188 shards running; no final result claimed here
